Method of Attack: Typosquatting by submitting packages with names very similar to popular legitimate packages
Spoofing module details including Author and Copyright to impersonate legitimate projects
Exposing unlisted packages via an accessible XML file containing comprehensive package details
Attack Vector: Uploading malicious packages with deceptive names to the PowerShell Gallery repository
Manipulating package metadata to appear trustworthy
Accessing unlisted package data through an exposed API XML endpoint
Indicators of Compromise: XML file exposing both listed and unlisted packages and their versions
Spoofed Author and Copyright metadata fields
